svg.text: IS16 Robot Car: Software Block Diagram (micro T-Kernel 3.0 on Pico W)
P = task priority (1 = highest), B1..B5 = owner (Buddy). Every autonomous motor command goes through the Vehicle Controller; only Safety may brake directly.
CLI + web UI: live telemetry, START / STOP / RESET / bc_map
via MQTT broker over Wi-Fi (binary frames v1, car/status LWT)
B3 · 5 ms ADC (straddle L+R; edge fallback)
bounded line-loss detection & search · IR_SENSOR fault
B3 · polls edge ring every 2 ms (2 ms glitch filter)
B5 · 60 ms grid · watch ahead 90° (< 25 cm ×2 → halt)
RELEASE → hand back to Line Following; abort on fault
(P4 sets LINE_FOUND; P7 sets AVOID_ACTIVE / REACQUIRED)
steer, JUNCTION, TRACK_LOST, barcode, bypass, remote
B2 · single arbitration point (10-state System FSM)
Safety / Remote > Avoid > Barcode (60 cm) > Line
clears FAULT_LATCHED on RESET after 500 ms still
4 × motion_cmd_t · polled every 20 ms (100 ms hold)
B2 · 20 ms · per-wheel PID + sync (cap 50 cm/s)
move / turn / U-turn / steer targets / stop (subsystem2.h)
gradual IMU-pitch climb boost on humps
speed + distance from encoders; stall / enc fault bits
read by P2 VC, P4 LF, P5 BC, P6/P7 Obs, P8 IMU, P9 Tel
B1 · 20 ms wake · pub 200 ms · HB 1 s + state change
16-slot drop-oldest outbox · 5 s KA, 1–30 s backoff
binary cmd check: start/stop/reset → VC; bc_map → P5
reads IF-12 snapshots (IR, range, att, obs) & MTX_MOTION
events: barcode (A–Z), hump, fault, VC state change
B4 · 10 ms · LSM303 accel via I2C1 (80 ms LPF)
lift / overturn (> 30° or > 0.10 m/s for 50 ms)
publishes pitch/roll (IF-12 & hump boost to P3)
B4 / B2 · highest priority · waits on EVF_SAFETY
brakes on LIFTED or 50 ms IMU_ALIVE timeout
sets FAULT_LATCHED (+ IMU_WDOG); posts fault event
never takes MTX_MOTION; brakes via IF-11 only

g.text: IF-12 lock-free snapshots: IR raws (P4), range + obs profile (P6), pitch/roll (P8)

svg.text: Hardware drivers (SDK side, kernel-free drv_*.c; isolated by check_rules.cmake); interrupts hand off through counters, rings or SEM_ECHO.
Notes: Debug Drain (P10, debug builds only) is the sole caller of USB CDC stdio; every task logs via a lock-free dbg_ ring so no control task blocks on console I/O.
On-target self-test task runs at P11 when APP_TEST=ON. P6 sets/clears EVF_SAFETY NO_ECHO (info); P9 sets/clears WIFI_LOSS.
